newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Zedillo details Guadalajara water plans.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Zedillo details Guadalajara water plans.

text.p: President Zedillo said Thursday the federal government would foot the bill for 50 percent of a new water supply and drainage system to cost 2.5 billion pesos for nation's second city of Guadalajara.
"This project will represent investment of 2.5 billion pesos, of which the federal government will be responsible for 50 percent,' Zedillo said.
Zedillo said the government had requested loans for $200 million for this purpose from Japanese financial bodies, which were "in the final stage of negotiation."
The state government of Jalisco, where Gudalajara is capital, will supply the remaining half of the project costs.
